title: Mastery & Nuance Practice - Fill in the Blanks
description: Complete sentences using this unit's B2 level phrases: necessity, wishes, emotions, hypotheticals, and more!
can_do: Apply subjunctive and conditional structures in context

items.text: ___ que tu manges quelque chose.
items.gloss: 'You need to eat something' (directed necessity)

items.text: Il faut ___ tu sois sage!
items.gloss: 'You need to be good!' (parent to child)

items.text: Je veux ___ tu viennes avec moi.
items.gloss: 'I want you to come with me' (expressing a wish)

items.text: J'aimerais que nous ___ ensemble.
items.gloss: 'I'd like us to go together' (polite wish)

items.text: Je suis content que tu ___ là!
items.gloss: 'I'm happy you're here!' (emotion about someone)

items.text: J'ai peur qu'il ___.
items.gloss: 'I'm afraid he'll leave' (worry)

items.text: ___ j'étais riche, j'achèterais une maison.
items.gloss: 'If I were rich, I'd buy a house' (daydream)

items.text: Si j'avais plus de temps, je ___ plus.
items.gloss: 'If I had more time, I'd travel more' (hypothetical)

items.text: Si j'avais su, j'___ continué mes études.
items.gloss: 'If I had known, I would have continued my studies' (regret)

items.text: J'avais ___ fini quand il est arrivé.
items.gloss: 'I had already finished when he arrived' (sequencing past events)

items.text: Je pense qu'il ___.
items.gloss: 'I think he's coming' (positive opinion)
items.hint: normal form after positive '{je pense que}'

items.text: Je ne pense pas qu'il ___.
items.gloss: 'I don't think he's coming' (diplomatic doubt)
items.hint: special form after negative '{je ne pense pas que}'

items.text: ___ qu'on parte, il faut finir.
items.gloss: 'Before we leave, we need to finish' (temporal)

items.text: Je t'explique ___ tu comprennes.
items.gloss: 'I'm explaining so you understand' (purpose)

items.text: ___ j'aie peu d'argent, je suis content.
items.gloss: 'Although I have little money, I'm happy' (contrast)

items.text: Je suis ___ content de te voir!
items.gloss: 'I'm really happy to see you!' (emphasis)

items.text: ___ mangeant, nous parlions.
items.gloss: 'While eating, we were talking' (simultaneous actions)

items.text: Je me fais ___ les cheveux demain.
items.gloss: 'I'm getting my hair cut tomorrow' (service)

items.text: Il est possible ___ soit en retard.
items.gloss: 'It's possible he's late' (uncertainty)

items.text: Si j'étais toi, je ___ que tu ___ tes rêves.
items.gloss: 'If I were you, I'd want you to follow your dreams' (advice + wish)
